content_sections.heading: RMC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must have passed ITI in the relevant trade from a government-recognized Industrial Training Institute . Applicants who have already completed apprenticeship training in any trade at RMC or another institution are not eligible. Candidates who have successfully completed ITI in the relevant advertised trade. Candidates whose ITI qualification is from a government-recognized institution. Candidates who have not previously completed apprenticeship training in any trade at RMC or another organization. Candidates who can complete both the online application and mandatory document-submission requirements within the prescribed dates. Important: Candidates who have already completed apprenticeship training in any trade at Rajkot Municipal Corporation or another institution should not apply. Such applicants will be disqualified if identified.

content_sections.heading: RMC Apprentice Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible ITI candidates can apply for RMC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 through the official Rajkot Municipal Corporation website between 2 November and 17 November 2026 . Official Application Website: RMC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Apprenticeship Application Page: RMC Apprentice Application Form Online Application Last Date: 17 November 2026. Important: The dedicated application page should be checked for the 2026 registration facility once the announced application period begins. After online submission, the application printout and documents must be presented in person by 23 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for RMC Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official Rajkot Municipal Corporation website at www.rmc.gov.in . Open the Apprenticeship Engagement Form or the relevant recruitment application section. Select the apprenticeship recruitment for 825 positions under the 2026 notification when available. Read the eligibility conditions and application instructions carefully. Select the relevant ITI trade from the available options. Enter the required personal, educational and contact details. Provide the relevant ITI qualification and certificate information requested in the form. Review the completed application carefully. Submit the online form by 17 November 2026 . Download and print the submitted application form. Attach self-attested copies of the supporting documents specified in the application form. Submit the printed application and documents in person at the designated RMC office by 23 November 2026 . Warning: Candidates who submit the online application but fail to present the required documents within the prescribed deadline will not be considered for further selection.

content_sections.heading: RMC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Document Submission Address
content_sections.text: After completing the online application, candidates must submit the printed form and required self-attested documents in person at the following address: To, The Manager, Establishment Branch, Room No. 1, Second Floor, Rajkot Municipal Corporation, Dhebarbhai Road, Rajkot - 360001, Gujarat. The submitted application must include the supporting documents required by the RMC application form. Candidates should not rely on online submission alone.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for RMC Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Printed online application form. ITI trade qualification certificate. Relevant ITI marksheet. Other educational and identity documents requested in the current online application. Any additional supporting documents specified in the application form. The exact document checklist should be followed as shown in the official RMC application form. All applicable copies must be self-attested.

content_sections.heading: RMC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Rajkot Municipal Corporation has announced 825 apprenticeship positions. Only candidates who have passed ITI in the relevant trade from a government-recognized institute can apply. Online applications are accepted from 2 November to 17 November 2026. The application must be submitted through the RMC website. The printed application and required self-attested documents must be submitted in person by 23 November 2026. Document submission is accepted during office working days between 10:30 AM and 6:10 PM. Failure to submit the required documents within the deadline will result in disqualification from further consideration. Candidates who have already completed apprenticeship training in any trade at RMC or another institution are not eligible. Selection will be made in merit order against available training positions. A merit-based waiting list may be used to fill positions becoming available later. Selected apprentices will receive the monthly stipend prescribed by the Government.

faq.question: Q1. How many apprentice seats does Rajkot Municipal Corporation have?
faq.answer: The notice advertises 825 vacant seats across various trades.

faq.question: Q2. Can I apply if I did my ITI from a private institute?
faq.answer: You can apply if the ITI is Government-recognised and you passed the course in the relevant trade.

faq.question: Q3. Is the online application enough on its own?
faq.answer: No. You must also hand in the application print and self-attested document copies at Room No. 1, Second Floor, at the corporation's Dhebarbhai Road office.

faq.question: Q4. Can I send my documents by post?
faq.answer: The notice requires them to be presented in person, between 10.30 am and 6.10 pm on office working days.

faq.question: Q5. I have already completed an apprenticeship elsewhere. Can I apply?
faq.answer: No. Candidates who have completed an apprenticeship in any trade, whether at Rajkot Municipal Corporation or another institution, should not apply.

faq.question: Q6. How are apprentices selected?
faq.answer: Selection is by order of merit, and a merit-based waiting list is used to fill seats that fall vacant later.

faq.question: Q7. What will selected apprentices be paid?
faq.answer: They receive a monthly stipend at the amount fixed by the Government.
